reviews.review:
Got a good way into the Veridian zone until I just couldn't take some of the encounter design anymore.
There's a lot of behind spawning enemies, enemies put together where their attacks are not made to synchronize into a dodgeable situation even if you take it slow and stop when you hear enemy spawns, long stretches of enemy spam where if you didn't have the RNG for bullet spawns you'll run out way before a checkpoint, overall overtuned statistics on enemies, quite a lot of non-viable weapon choices from the get go.

I was in good luck I decided to farm my stats to a 10/10/10/10 spread to try out as many starting weapons as I could and looting ammo boxes and healing items since there's good 10-30 minute stretches of tunnel-like areas where I would've dried out of ammo about 5 times over if I just progressed the game in every situation I could.

So overall what took me 1 or maybe 2 deaths to pass, might make a lot of others who've not played Dark Souls or Remnant From the Ashes before just ragequit since the encounter design is sloggy, zone-y and not active at all like the other games in the genre are.

And if you've played Dark Souls 1 this game pulls off the same teleportation locking mechanic, but as the stages are mostly linear in design you'll have none of that inter-connected adventure from Souls 1 and instead you'll need to run whole ways backwards after the second boss to go back to the hub.
